title: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI): One Policy per Insured
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI): One Policy per Insured

**Rule.** An insured holds at most one Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) policy; a different amount of coverage is a change to that policy, never a second one. A policy is issued only when the insured holds no VGLI policy whose status is issued, active, grace or lapsed. VALife may be held alongside VGLI.

The limit is 1 VGLI policy per insured.

## How the rule is applied

- **What is checked.** The insured's own VGLI policy records, as the system holds them at the moment a policy would be issued. What the insured says about their coverage does not replace the record; the statuses on file decide.
- **Whose records.** The policies counted are those held by the same insured who is applying. Another person's VGLI policy is not counted.
- **What bars issue.** Any VGLI policy of that insured whose status is one of the following four:

| Status of an existing VGLI policy | Meaning on the record | Bars issue of another policy |
|---|---|---|
| issued | application approved; first premium not yet received | yes |
| active | coverage in force | yes |
| grace | a premium is unpaid and the grace period is running | yes |
| lapsed | coverage ended for non-payment | yes |

A VGLI policy that is cancelled, converted or matured is not in any of the four statuses above, so it does not bar issue under this rule.

- **A change in amount.** Where an insured who already holds a VGLI policy wants a different amount of coverage, that is a change to the policy already held. It is never met by issuing a second VGLI policy.
- **VALife.** Holding VALife does not count against the limit; VALife may be held alongside VGLI.

## Cases (hypothetical insureds)

| Insured's existing VGLI records | Outcome under this rule |
|---|---|
| none | a policy may be issued |
| one policy, status active | no second policy is issued |
| one policy, status grace | no second policy is issued |
| one policy, status lapsed | no second policy is issued |
| one policy, status issued | no second policy is issued |
| one policy, status cancelled | this rule does not bar issue |
| one VALife policy and no VGLI policy | this rule does not bar issue |

## Basis questions

- *An insured holding an active $100,000 VGLI policy wants $200,000 of coverage. Is that a new policy?* No. A different amount of coverage is a change to the existing policy, never a second one.
- *Does a lapsed policy still count?* Yes. A lapsed policy is one of the four statuses that bar issue of another policy.
- *May an insured hold VALife and VGLI at the same time?* Yes. VALife may be held alongside VGLI.
